scope: Agent visual acceptance for the complete material-animation demo; not user approval or photorealistic fluid simulation.

scenes.finding: The original cargo ship travels left at scale 1, carries its authored reflection, leaves historical wakes and settles as harbor disturbance decays.
The small original duck leaves the pool edge, its reflection follows, and contact waves spread from earlier duck positions before subsiding.
The existing sails fill before the vessel advances left; three water contacts follow the bounded passage and resolve with the gust.
A warm source fragment descends across the courtyard, passes behind the lamp and rests while canopy light settles.
A directional breeze reaches the warm reeds and tidal channels at staggered times, then returns to stillness.
A canopy-derived shadow and cloud band cross the lawn, deepen mid-story and clear by the ending.
The existing lake duck glides right with its original reflection; its passage creates historical ripples while the shore duck stays still.
A passing gust moves the existing flag, nearby tree and narrow sea strip, with delayed response and a quiet ending.
Ambient exposure falls gently as existing warm observatory windows strengthen in sequence; the ending holds the lit building.
One breeze crosses the two flags, palm crowns and distant ocean before their movement subsides.
A restrained material swell approaches the authored coast, brightens at contact and withdraws to the initial water treatment.
A cloud band traverses the facades from left to right and clears, revealing the original warm architectural light.
A small original garden leaf falls onto the pool at 13 seconds, creates a fixed-origin ripple and remains floating as the water calms.
The original launch emerges from bridge occlusion, continues down the river at constant scale and leaves three historical contacts before resting.
Warm autumn foliage responds to the breeze while canopy-derived shadows pass across the snow, then clear.
One green source fragment drifts down through the oak, is hidden by the trunk and comes to rest as the tree-light event ends.
Two source-canopy projections and a passing cloud shade the gate approach, then restore the resting courtyard.
Overhead source foliage casts a moving dappled band across the pastel facades, then clears to the resting street.
Four attached moss groups respond to a breeze with lagging tips while light moves down the avenue and settles.
A warm light band travels across the salt-water pigment and fades; the corrected glint is no longer cancelled by cloud shading.
A passing breeze breaks the reflected stone columns and then allows their original arrangement to reform.
One low swell approaches the jetty, catches the existing shell relief, then withdraws and settles.
The original resting alligator makes two restrained torso breaths while the reeds and pond respond to a passing breeze and become still.
